evidence: One of the standout features of the Museum of Fine Arts Vietnam is its dedicated children’s creative space, inaugurated in 2011. Located on the third floor, this area offers young visitors the opportunity to engage in hands-on activities such as painting, sculpture, and craft-making, allowing them to explore their artistic talents while learning about traditional and modern Vietnamese art forms.
